coverage: Partial verified fallback; scheduled bulk refresh replaces this with the full matched NHTSA recall dataset.

recalls.subject: ADS may not detect heavy smoke in roadway
recalls.summary: Zoox ADS software may fail to detect heavy smoke, allowing the vehicle to enter a low-visibility area, particularly an active emergency response scene.
recalls.consequence: May increase collision risk in low-visibility emergency scenes.
recalls.remedy: Software update; consult NHTSA campaign record for completion status.

recalls.subject: ADS software may cause lane-line crossings near intersections
recalls.summary: Automated driving software could cause a vehicle to cross a center line or enter an oncoming path near intersections.

recalls.subject: ADS may not detect people immediately next to the vehicle
recalls.summary: ADS could allow vehicle movement after failing to detect a person very close to the vehicle.
recalls.remedy: Zoox reported implementing the remedy on affected vehicles by May 21, 2025.

recalls.subject: ADS prediction error may prevent avoiding a collision
recalls.summary: A vehicle emerging from a perpendicular driveway could be incorrectly predicted to enter the driving lane.
recalls.remedy: Zoox reported updating operating vehicles by April 17, 2025.

recalls.subject: Unexpected hard braking
recalls.summary: Zoox ADS may brake hard unexpectedly near certain motorcycles or cyclists.
